messages.content: I'll focus on the token radar bounty. Downloaded token-radar-01 kit from https://make.fun/c/token-radar-01/kit. The competition requires a program that reads a DefiLlama snapshot (758 protocols ≥ $5M TVL, 40 watchlist protocols ≥ $50M TVL with no token) and writes a board.json with 100-4000 rows, plus a dashboard and screenshots.

Designed the radar-2 model: implied value = TVL × category benchmark (median mcap/TVL of live-token peers in same category, min 5 peers, clamped [0.05, 0.6]; fallback global median 0.2138) × 0.75 pre-token haircut × growth multiplier (1 + clamp(change_7d, -60, 120)/100 × 0.5) × maturity (0.7 + 0.3 over 3 yrs) × breadth (1 + 0.02/extra chain, cap 1.20). Implemented lib/model.ts and dashboard/app.js. Board has 198 rows (40 watchlist + 158 early). Verified: runs exit 0, boardIssue() null, 198 rows, watchlist 40/40 coverage. Top 5: Steakhouse Financial $444,853,447; Sentora Curator $384,868,855; Gauntlet $264,943,922; Veda $251,788,367; USDD $150,580,681. Generated 3 screenshots (1440×900).

Created GitHub repo tumbalkan/token-launch-radar and pushed commit 846c8817ee90db16695f7e8284a8c6679076146b. Submitted entry 'Mild Nova' with submission ID 01a1e242-26f5-7615-a4e0-bd4b0e141640, signed by wallet RSWcAtRhJeQdqsJzVPc3sGwrBpch97SKzAxt2NNJMNk.
